description:
An Unparalleled Standard of Luxury Living Presenting the pinnacle of sophisticated townhouse living—where bespoke concierge service is available 24 hours a day, and access to an exceptional suite of residents-only amenities includes elegant meeting rooms, a tranquil library, artisan coffee lounge, indulgent sauna and steam rooms, and serene treatment rooms, to name just a few. 

An exclusive townhouse which offers striking architectural design, opulent interiors & expansive private terrace, and beautifully landscaped communal grounds. The Heart of Dublin’s Most Prestigious Neighbourhood Perfectly positioned in the verdant surroundings of Ballsbridge, Lansdowne Place enjoys a truly enviable address in one of Dublin’s most sought-after neighbourhoods. 

Steeped in history dating back to the 1600s, Ballsbridge seamlessly blends timeless charm—exemplified by its red-brick Victorian architecture—with the vibrancy of a modern, cosmopolitan village. This refined district is home to numerous embassies and diplomatic residences, offering a sense of security, exclusivity, and international prestige. Effortless Living, 

Thoughtfully Delivered A dedicated team of highly trained staff is on hand around the clock to anticipate and attend to your every need. From dry cleaning to deliveries, key-holding, meeting room bookings, car hire, ticket reservations, and event planning—every detail is curated to your lifestyle. At Lansdowne Place, community and connection are just as important as comfort and convenience. It’s not just a residence; it’s a way of life.

This property measures 191 sq.m approx. with a further 17sq.m terrace
